title: Biplane Rides: Magic Air Tours
specs: Flight in a beautifully restored 1927 TravelAir Biplane
Climb to 3000 feet over Mt. Constitution for a 360 degree panorama
includes: Warm jacket that is also a flotation device
blurb: Guests fly in an open front cockpit biplane over five San Juan Islands, culminating with a climb to 3000 feet over Mt. Constitution for a 360 degree panorama. Flights last 35-45 minutes. Leather helmets, goggles, and a warm jacket that doubles as a flotation device are provided.
extraNote: Reservations by appointment only · Orcas Island Airport, 109 Schoen Ln, Eastsound, WA 98245 · 2026 Summer Season
